svg.aria-label: The 76-vertex unit-distance graph over Q(sqrt11), which needs four colours
svg.text: A plane over a real quadratic field that needs four colours: ℚ(√11)
76 points, 172 segments of length exactly 1; no 3-colouring exists. One 4-colouring is shown.
Dashed: the unit circle around the point at the origin, which has 26 neighbours on it.
Shapes and colours: the four colour classes of a proper 4-colouring.
